Daniel

If you're not going to work with CmdStan, I think that's fine. The idea of the submodule is to be able to keep everyone playing with CmdStan in synch with a commit of Stan.

I think what you've done is checked out Stan within CmdStan and not as a submodule.

When you change stan within cmdstan and you type 'git status' from cmdstan, do you see changes to the stan folder?

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] CmdStan setup

On Wednesday, March 12, 2014 3:07:58 PM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
Ok. If there's anything that could help, let me know. Like creating a make target that will print out all the tests individually.

That would help if it were formatted with one line per test so that I could easily redirect it to a file. Right now, I am just doing calls to find that mostly duplicate what is inside make/tests but it would be less brittle to have a make target for that purpose. The main thing is that, while I can pre-build all the common dependencies, each subsequent call to make should run exactly one test file.

Ben
